title: Implement the Goal Gravity loop on the canonical standing runtime (main), reusing the ledger, policy engine, Consequence Gate and genome registry; preserve the unmerged greg/ lineages as substrate; adoption into main is a founder decision
problem: Observation: the 2026-10-13 founder directive names nine literal implementation targets (A-I), fourteen deterministic scenarios and a section-33 acceptance chain for a persistent goal-attractor behavior. Observation: kernel main (19fa33c, 626 tests green) carries standing cognition (signals, idempotent ticks, suspend/resume), a durable workflow spine, a hash-chained ledger, a policy engine and Consequence Gate, causal memory, a capability genome registry and the morphogenesis target-state contracts, but no goal persistence, relevance routing, wake/sleep, executable Backcast GPS, intervention classification, world-model integration, intersection detection, retention or attention routing. Observation: fifty open draft PRs form stacked GREG lineages off main (#114/#137 greg/missions.py+asks.py+genesis.py; #158 greg/gravity.py one-turn Goal Gravity; #93/#97/#109 Goal Chase sandbox) with overlapping, unmerged mechanisms awaiting founder decisions. Inference: the residual CapabilityDeficit on the canonical line is targets A-I themselves. Unresolved claim: which lineage mechanisms should be ported first. Proposed action: build the residual on main inside egregore/, composed over existing machinery, as a draft PR.
baseline: Kernel main 19fa33c: egregore/runtime.py StandingCognitionRuntime (SignalEnvelope ingest, CandidateProposal deliberation, hash-authorized resume), events/spine.py DurableWorkflow, provenance/ledger.py EvidenceLedger, policy/engine.py evaluate + policy/consequence_gate.py ConsequenceGate, memory/causal.py CausalMemory, capabilities/genome.py GenomeRegistry, morphogenesis/engine.py MetricTarget error arithmetic, docs/BACKCAST_GPS.md as prose only. 626 tests pass, 4 skipped. No goal persists across a restart; no event wakes anything.

alternatives.name: Extend the canonical runtime on main (selected)
alternatives.description: Nine modules inside egregore/ (goals, experience, relevance, gps, interventions, intersections, retention, attention, gravity) hydrated from the one EvidenceLedger, classifying moves through policy.engine.evaluate and executing only through ConsequenceGate.run with caller-supplied grants; two additive contracts; five closures on the integration registry.
advantages: Composes the ratified canonical machinery instead of a draft stack
Mergeable against main with the full suite green
No second Kernel, mission authority plane, identity plane or evidence plane
Every directive target lands as testable code on the line organs actually pin
disadvantages: Mechanisms overlapping #158/#137/#97 are re-expressed rather than ported byte-for-byte
Relevance routing is deterministic rule matching, not learned
The loop holds no grants, so autonomous execution depends on a grant-issuing caller

alternatives.name: Stack on draft #158 (claude/greg-polyintelligence-mind)

Credits the most recent lineage directly

73k added lines on that branch; the mission path there is itself EXPERIMENT with negative P4 results

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: The directive remains an aspiration; goals keep living only in chat sessions; the fifty-PR graph keeps growing without a canonical goal substrate on main.
advantages: No risk of mis-reading the directive
disadvantages: The founder's literal targets stay unbuilt on the canonical line
Every future session reconstructs the plan by hand, which the directive names as the failure to remove

roles.position: The directive is explicit about what it is (an operating-behavior clarification with literal targets A-I and acceptance tests) and what it is not (a replacement architecture, a parallel GREG, a consciousness claim). Building A-I as an extension of the canonical runtime with the verbatim source preserved and the metaphors compiled to effects is the faithful reading. The rhetorical preamble (meniscus, impermeable shield, systemic dominance) is recorded verbatim and compiled to the strongest defensible frontier, layered recovery and lawful capability, as the founder's own translation paragraph instructs.
material_concerns: Over-literalizing 'coincidence production' into anything that claims to control chance
Shrinking the destination to what the deterministic loop can do today

roles.position: One ledger, one Gate, one policy engine, one genome registry; goals are data hydrated like standing-cognition signals; the loop is idempotent per trigger_id exactly as cognition ticks are; drift is detected from the Gate's own action events via the proposal-id convention; the morphogenesis MetricTarget arithmetic is reused for the SBM gap. No new authority object exists. The two contracts are additive and are not added to the pinned boundary allowlist, so the shared package is untouched.
material_concerns: Proposal-id prefix convention for drift detection is a soft coupling that must be documented
Grant supply is external to the loop; a future scheduler must obtain grants through the existing issuer, never mint them

roles.position: Strongest attack: this is a third goal/mission lineage next to #137 and #158, which the directive forbids ('do not create a parallel GREG'). Counter: the drafts are not canonical and are not mergeable; the canonical line had nothing; the new code composes main's authority path rather than duplicating it, and the drafts' mechanisms are credited and preserved for reconciliation. Second attack: 'autonomous execution' is thin because grants are caller-supplied. Counter: that is the constitutional design (the Gate consumes grants, it never fills them in), and the tests prove execution occurs only under a pre-existing grant. Third attack: deterministic relevance matching will miss unstructured reality. Accepted: the router is the baseline; proposers/models plug into standing cognition later and must beat it.
material_concerns: Third-lineage risk if the founder later merges #137/#158 without reconciliation
Auto-retained 'evidence' assets could inflate the compounding metric if read naively

roles.position: Pure stdlib plus existing kernel modules; no services, brokers, models or credentials; the full suite runs in about 30 seconds; closures register on the integration registry so the verifier covers the loop; the README carries the buildability standard. Rollback is reverting one draft branch. The scheduler and sensor adapters remain to be chosen (cron/APScheduler/Temporal) and are founder activation decisions.
material_concerns: Ledger growth: each turn appends several records; JSONL persistence will need rotation or Postgres before 24/7 use
The loop processes every awake goal serially; fine at tens of goals, not thousands

roles.position: No external effects, no real people contacted, no data subjects; every founder ask carries a no-cost option and no manufactured urgency; refusals are remembered; 'stop pushing', 'do not monitor', 'never use tactic' are enforced before policy. Evidence tiers are stated exactly: IMPLEMENTED, UNIT-TESTED, INTEGRATION-TESTED on synthetic ledgers; not sandbox-verified against a live sensor, not externally verified, not founder-accepted. The experience surface metric is explicitly not a consciousness score.
material_concerns: Wording that could be read as 'GREG experiences reality' must stay bounded to the functional definition
Privacy: do_not_monitor is per goal; a global mute belongs to a later founder control surface

pass_1.intended_outcome: Authorized goals become persistent attractors on the canonical runtime: they survive restarts, sleep at zero cost, wake from relevant evidence, favorable intersections or cadence, compute their active gate and SBM from provenance-backed beliefs, execute only permitted moves through the Gate, prepare everything else, interrupt the founder rarely and with compressed decisions, and leave durable assets that make later goals cheaper.

advantages.statement: One substrate for goals on the line organs pin
advantages.amplified_value: Every future sensor, proposer, scheduler and organ plugs into the same registry and contracts; the moat is the ledger-anchored goal history, reusable across ventures

Grows into a safe default pathway: as grants widen, autonomy widens without any code change in the loop; reverses into a liability only if a caller mints grants outside the issuer, which the Gate refuses

advantages.statement: Compounding is anchored to ledgered outcomes
advantages.amplified_value: Retention cannot be claimed from prose; capabilities registered through retention carry bounded envelopes, so compounding capability never compounds authority
More sensing yields fewer, better asks rather than more notifications; the no-cost-option guard converts a welfare risk into a structural invariant

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Record the overlap in the ADR with exact paths; credit the drafts; define the reconciliation adapters; make adoption a founder decision; no draft is closed or deleted

pass_2.attack_summary: Assume Pass 1 shipped. Attacks: (1) the loop becomes the de facto mission system and the drafts rot, so reconciliation never happens; (2) a scheduler is wired without grants and the loop silently prepares forever, which reads as 'working' while nothing moves; (3) goal specs become a planning authority that reviewers cite as permission; (4) ledger growth from per-turn records; (5) the robotics fixture overfits the tests to one goal shape; (6) the directive's rhetoric ('systemic dominance') is quoted as if achieved.

new_weaknesses.statement: A turn that only prepares can be mistaken for progress
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: GravityTurn reports executed/prepared/escalated separately; status() exposes evidence_state per route; CMC stays the single bottleneck metric and is unchanged at 0
Every goal record carries authority_note 'declared lineage; not founder authentication; grants no execution authority' and execution_authority 'none' in the contract
Dormant goals append nothing; a turn with no woken goal appends one record; rotation/Postgres is an operator decision before 24/7 use, recorded as a residual risk
Closure probes use a different minimal goal; the attention test uses six synthetic goals; the acceptance test uses two goals with different plans
The intent record and README state the evidence tier per target; 'systemic dominance' compiles only to lawful capability and is never used as a status label

Adoption into main, scheduler activation, sensor adapters and founder authentication remain founder decisions.

kill_criteria: Any execution path in the loop that bypasses ConsequenceGate.run or mints a grant
A route executed twice after restart in any test or rehearsal
An ask reaching the founder without a no-cost option or with manufactured urgency
A founder refusal followed by an unchanged re-proposal
The loop presented as evidence that GREG 'experiences reality' or 'creates coincidences'
review_trigger: Founder review of the draft PR; any merge of #137/#148/#155/#158; first scheduler or sensor adapter calling GoalGravityLoop.turn
